protocol.mixture: Equal arithmetic mean only, no weight search
protocol.gate: Both seeds delta > 0.001 and paired bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0
protocol.compute: No Optuna, no early stopping using outer labels; reuse feature fits, at most 2 new base model types; stop after screening if all new choices fail to beat reference by 0.001.
protocol.history: This is a sequential hypothesis informed by phase1/2. Outer splits have historical reuse, not a new blind test. No actual Kaggle score is measured.
